V1.1_no_shock_stability.rule: N: |rent_index_all M36 - M12| <= 3.0 and mean vacancy M13-36 in [3%, 12%]

V1.2_burden_gradient.rule: N tail, formal market (excl. 低价房), pooled tenant-months: rent/income low > mid > high in >= 80% of seeds; AND within every room kind, groups with >= 30 tenant-months (pooled over seeds) are strictly decreasing
V1.2_burden_gradient.source: stylized fact (lower-income renters bear higher burden); scope rationale in Lease_Day_v0.7_理论与实证依据.md §3-4

V1.3_rent_commute_tradeoff.rule: N tail: Spearman(zone whole-unit rent, subway minutes) < 0
V1.3_rent_commute_tradeoff.source: bid-rent theory; partly an input property of the board, so this checks it is preserved

V1.4_opening_premium_sign.rule: S - N treated rent index at M36 > 0 (seed mean)
V1.4_opening_premium_sign.source: line_rent_results.md point estimates are positive for Lines 14/16

V1.5_announcement_effect_sign.rule: P - S treated rent index at M24 > 0 (seed mean)
V1.5_announcement_effect_sign.source: literature on anticipation (e.g., McMillen & McDonald 2004; Knaap et al. 2001) - direction only
V1.5_announcement_effect_sign.verdict: N/A (rule agents ignore the announcement by design)

V2.1_opening_premium_magnitude.rule: S vs N treated premium (%) at M36 inside Line 14 95% CI [-1.5, 6.7]

value.caveats: model = 12 months after opening, all rooms (contract + asking); data = 1.5-2.5 years after opening, asking rents of 30-150 m2 listings; shock size differs

V2.2_commute_level.rule: N mean one-way commute within 48 min +/-10% [43.2, 52.8] (weakly independent: not a calibration target, but TAU may have been chosen with it in mind); share >60 min reported vs 28-31%, not gated
V2.2_commute_level.source: CAUPD/Baidu Maps 2022 Annual China Major Cities Commuting Monitoring Report (Beijing 2021: 48 min, >60 min 30%); see analysis/v22_commute_target.md

value.caveats: weakly independent; population = CBD renters vs all central-city commuters; model has no peak congestion

V3_micro_behaviour.rule: not testable: no individual landlord/tenant rental panel

level_reached: Level 1 met; Level 2 partial (V2.1 CONSISTENT, V2.2 CONSISTENT); Level 3 not testable
